name: @olai/ops
//exports: Three entries, and only the first is product. `./testlib` is the planner context this package's own tests run on — ids counted from `n1`, one fixed instant — published so the package ABOVE can drive the ops layer the same way; the alternative was @olai/server keeping its own copy of that instant, which is a fixture drifting from the one the assertions in here are written against. Same argument, and the same shape, as @olai/format's. `./testlib/tools` is the second door for the same reason one layer up: the walk over the tool table has to be run TWICE now — once here with no matcher and once in olai-plugin-search with one — and two copies of a maximal fixture is two things to keep maximal. Its own door rather than a re-export, because a harness is not a fixture.
//dependencies: Between `format` and `server` (docs/architecture.md): the ops layer knows what an edit MEANS and how a write is made durable, and nothing about a listener, a socket or a browser. @olai/format supplies the records, the rules, the canonical bytes and the refusal vocabulary; @olai/store supplies the one write gate. TWO doors this layer defines and does not stand behind, both of them plugins: the LEDGER (git) and the MATCHER (search). Each is called through and refuses in words when nobody is mounted. @olai/index used to be a dependency here — the trigram table a directory search takes its candidates from — and it left with the walk that spends it, so this package holds no index at all now. @olai/surface is deliberately absent — an op does not know it is being called over a wire.
//devDependencies: @effect/platform-node is the FileSystem the tests drive a real temp directory through, exactly as @olai/store's are. @types/node is for the node built-ins the tests reach for. @olai/log is here for its `./testlib` collector ONLY — hearing a log line has exactly one spelling in this tree. It is deliberately not a runtime dependency: the levels and the verbs are Effect's, so nothing in src/ imports it.
